strings.אין שמירה אוטומטית ואין שליחה לרשת. השתמ: Nothing is saved automatically or sent over the network. Use fictional information for review. If an answer does not fit, shorten it or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Check print preview.
strings.אין תרגיל נשימה, גוף או הרפיה שחובה לבצע: No breathing, body or relaxation exercise is mandatory. Reassess unsuitable tools. Do not require distress to disappear before continuing treatment or make a tool compulsory for every encounter with a reminder.
strings.אפשר להציע קריאה, זמן ושיחה לפי העדפה. ס: Offer reading support, time, and conversation according to preference. Choose help from another person together with the participant, respecting their privacy.
strings.ב־AD מקשרים הסבר על תגובות למשמעות ולמטר: AD connects response explanations to meaning and goals in the chosen CPT plan. Support tools do not replace exploring thoughts in treatment or require complete calm beforehand.
strings.ב־CH משתמשים בשמות רגשות שהילד מבין ובדו: CH uses emotion words the child understands and chosen everyday examples. Supporters can help identify and express needs without ordering calm or dictating answers.
strings.ב־OA בודקים העדפות, מגבלות גופניות ושינו: OA assesses preferences, physical limitations and new changes individually. Offer alternatives or assistance by request, not a uniform exercise based on age assumptions.
strings.ב־TE נותנים מקום למבוכה, לאוטונומיה ולהב: TE allows for embarrassment, autonomy and differences between home and school. Choose tools with the teenager without requiring family reports of every response.
strings.בדקו אם ההסבר ברור ואם כלי התמיכה מסייע: Check explanation clarity and whether support aids functioning and choice. Immediate tension reduction is not the only measure. Adapt next steps without requiring complete calm.
strings.בחרו את גרסת הגיל ואת השאלות הרלוונטיות;: Choose the age version and relevant questions; completing every sheet is not a condition for progress. W accompanies professional conversation. P records only pre-agreed follow-up. Unit number does not mean session number.
strings.בחרו בדף לאחר הערכה מקצועית ובהסכמה. אפש: Choose this sheet following professional assessment and with consent. The person may skip questions, answer aloud, or choose another tool. This is proposed original material for review; it provides no score, diagnosis, or promise of an outcome.
strings.בררו כיצד המלווה יכול להקשיב לרגש, לתמוך: Explore how supporters can listen, support and seek help without silencing distress. Choose routine support together and assess their distress separately without making the child soothe them.
strings.דוגמה בדויה: מיה מגלה שהתרכזות בנשימה אי: Fictional example: Maya finds focusing on breathing unpleasant. She tells the therapist and they explore another support option within the plan, without inferring she is unready for treatment.
strings.דף P מתעד תמיכה ולמידה שסוכמו בטיפול. הו: P records support and learning agreed in treatment. It sets no exposure, trauma narrative, dosage or component sequence. Without a plan, bring questions to the session. CH/TE sheets do not replace separate supporter work; AD/OA sheets are not official CPT materials.

strings.האם השימוש נעשה גמיש או הפך לתנאי קבוע?: Was use flexible or did it become a fixed requirement?
strings.האם נדרש בירור של שינוי גופני או מעשי חד: Does a new physical or practical change need assessment?

strings.הציעו שאלה אחת בכל פעם ומעט כתיבה. תיווך: Offer one question at a time with little writing. Adult support must not replace the child's own voice.
strings.הקישורים הבאים שימשו לרקע בלבד. השאלות ו: The following links were used for background only. Questions and adaptations were written afresh for the expansion plan; no questionnaire, scale, or protocol was copied. Adult sources do not validate the child versions. This material makes no claim about session count or treatment effectiveness.
strings.חברו את ההסבר לקשרים בין פירוש, רגש ותפק: Connect the explanation to interpretation, emotion and functioning. Do not add mandatory regulation before CPT or turn child materials into adult treatment instructions.

strings.טיוטה לסקירה. דף לשיחה עם מטפל המיומן בט: Draft for review. Discuss with a trauma-skilled therapist; not diagnosis or independent processing instructions.
strings.טיוטה לסקירה. מתעדים המשך שנבחר עם המטפל: Draft for review. Record follow-up chosen with the therapist; do not start trauma processing using this sheet alone.
strings.טיוטה לסקירת מנהל. סקירה קלינית ואישור ז: Draft for administrator review. Clinical review and final rights approval are still pending.

strings.כשכלי אינו עוזר, בררו מה התרחש במקום להו: When a tool does not help, explore events rather than automatically adding repetitions. New or unusual physical responses need suitable assessment; not every bodily sign is trauma-related.

strings.סכמו מה הובן ומה נשאר פתוח. היעזרו ב־SES: Summarize what became clearer and what remains open. Use the existing SES-S01 and SES-S02 for the session framework. There is no need to repeat an assessment or plan already recorded.
strings.סכמו מראש מה משתפים ועם מי, ואת גבולות ה: Agree in advance what will be shared and with whom, and explain the privacy limits in this setting. Do not promise absolute confidentiality.

strings.קיימת רשומת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסה: התאמת: Each version has a separate review record covering age suitability, originality, rights, and fictional filling. Reviewer and date fields remain blank until assigned. File checks or a code merge are not clinical approval. Clinical information stays only in the authorized setting, outside the code repository.
